title: nmis_primary_estimates.tsv
description: Row schema for nmis_primary_estimates.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF, header row required.

n_observed.description: Occurrences with a detection at or before 10 kb.

n_censored_at_10kb.description: Occurrences right-censored at 10 kb: no detection within the window. NOT evidence of absence.

F_1000.description: Weighted cumulative detection F(1000 bp): the block-balanced share of occurrences whose nearest qualifying element lies within 1000 bp, under right-censoring at 10 kb.

F_2000.description: Weighted cumulative detection F(2000 bp): the block-balanced share of occurrences whose nearest qualifying element lies within 2000 bp, under right-censoring at 10 kb.

F_5000.description: Weighted cumulative detection F(5000 bp): the block-balanced share of occurrences whose nearest qualifying element lies within 5000 bp, under right-censoring at 10 kb.

F_10000.description: Weighted cumulative detection F(10000 bp): the block-balanced share of occurrences whose nearest qualifying element lies within 10000 bp, under right-censoring at 10 kb.

F_1000_ci95.description: 95 % BioProject cluster bootstrap interval for F(1000 bp), as [lower, upper].

F_2000_ci95.description: 95 % BioProject cluster bootstrap interval for F(2000 bp), as [lower, upper].

F_5000_ci95.description: 95 % BioProject cluster bootstrap interval for F(5000 bp), as [lower, upper].

F_10000_ci95.description: 95 % BioProject cluster bootstrap interval for F(10000 bp), as [lower, upper].

restricted_mean_distance_bp.description: E[min(D, 10000)]: restricted mean distance under censoring at 10 kb.

restricted_mean_distance_bp_ci95.description: 95 % BioProject cluster bootstrap interval for the restricted mean distance, as [lower, upper].

auc_detection_bp.description: Area under the cumulative detection curve to 10 kb.

median_distance_bp.description: Median distance, or 'not reached' where F(10 kb) < 0.5.
